  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ. (source PMID 30392755 table X)",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness. (source PMID 30392755 table X)",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma and, whenever possible, in the same operative setting. (source PMID 30392755 table X)",
  "The consensus‑based recommendation for primary excision of melanoma is that the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis. (source PMID 39709737 recommendation‑1)",
  "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions. (source PMID 39709737 recommendation‑1)",
  "The consensus rate for the primary excision recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts). (source PMID 39709737 recommendation‑1)",
  "The override increased the 7‑point score from 6 to 8.",
  "The management recommendation remains unchanged; excision is still indicated."
]
